scope: One venue only: saitama-city-culture-main さいたま市文化センター〔大ホール〕. No other venue was researched, re-audited, or reopened.

disposition: HOLD — RENOVATION / CURRENTNESS HOLD. Not promoted to production.
dispositionSummary: The bounded implementation stopped at the first gate. The operator's own current facility page, corroborated by the City of Saitama's official facility page, announces a facility-wide 休館 beginning 令和9年6月1日 (2027-06-01) for a 中規模修繕工事 expected to last approximately two years. That is 9 months after this review date, inside the 12-month operational threshold in docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.md, which directs that a venue with an officially announced cessation of operation within 12 months is blocked in principle and that exception judgments must not be made by inference. No fresh visual two-pass transcription, source JSON, range, fingerprint, generated artifact, or production integration was created.

currentnessCheck.result: FAILED — officially announced facility-wide closure within the 12-month threshold

currentnessCheck.policyBasis: docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.md: 改修中、長期休館中、閉館済み、または座席構成を変える改修・運用終了が公式発表済みの会場は新規production化しません。「近い将来」は独立レビュー日から12か月以内を運用上の目安とし、予定日、公式確認日、blocking reason、再確認条件をinventoryへ記録します。現在activeでも12か月以内の終了予定がある場合は原則blockedとし、例外判断を推測で行いません。
currentnessCheck.whyNoExceptionWasTaken: The issuer does not state whether the 中規模修繕工事 changes the seating configuration. Under the same policy sentence, that unknown must not be resolved by inference in either direction, so the announced closure alone is dispositive and no exception was constructed.
currentnessCheck.preflightGap: The 2026-08-27 preflight did not record this notice. The notice is not new: a local news item dated 2026-01-27 already reported the 2027-06 closure, so the notice predates that preflight rather than post-dating it. The same preflight did apply a currentness yield penalty to kanagawa-pacifico-national-hall for a comparable 2027-05-17 closure, so this is a missed check in that wave, not a policy change here. The ADOPT disposition is therefore corrected on current evidence rather than overridden.

configurationAssessment.representativeDecision: A仕様 would be the representative configuration if this venue were implementable.
configurationAssessment.representativeRationale: The decision rests on issuer evidence, not on A being larger. A仕様 is the only configuration for which the issuer publishes a complete printed numbered set: the one linked 座席表（大ホール）'s own printed grand total (計2,006席) and its printed per-floor subtotals (1,328 / 330 / 348) equal the A仕様 published capacity exactly, identifying that chart as the A仕様 chart. For B仕様 the issuer publishes only the aggregate 1,658 and a 客席奥行 dimension; it publishes no B chart, no B fixed/movable split, and no statement of which printed positions B removes. Implementing B would therefore require inventing the configuration difference and deleting numbered positions to reach 1,658 — capacity fitting and repository-invented differences, both prohibited. A is selected as the only issuer-evidenced representative set, and B is not implementable on current material.
configurationAssessment.explicitlyRejectedInference: 2,006 − 1,658 = 348 equals the printed 3階客席(348席) subtotal exactly, which would suggest B closes the third floor. This arithmetic identity is NOT adopted as evidence. The issuer describes B as a reduced 客席奥行, never as a floor closure, and an unstated mechanism must not be reconstructed from arithmetic. It is recorded only as an open question for any future reopening.
configurationAssessment.scopeDiscipline: Only one representative configuration was assessed for implementation. No A+B dual-configuration implementation was designed or authored, and no seat set was mixed between modes.

corroboratingIssuerDocument.finding: The 大ホール断面図 (2020.12.28 作成) and 大ホール客席図 (1:250) pages both carry the printed legend 固定客席 1842席：車椅子席 8席／収容定員 2006席：移動席(オケピ)156席, which independently confirms the chart header's fixed/movable/wheelchair split and identifies the 156 movable seats as the orchestra-pit area seats.

capacityAndSemanticsReconciliation.note: Established from printed issuer material only, at the level needed to record the blocker accurately. It is not a substitute for the two-pass transcription, which was not performed.
capacityAndSemanticsReconciliation.publishedTotalRelation: The A仕様 published capacity 2,006 equals the seat chart's own printed grand total 計2,006席 and equals the sum of its printed floor subtotals 1,328 + 330 + 348. The chart and the capacity statement agree with no residual.
capacityAndSemanticsReconciliation.fixedMovableDefinition: Within the single A configuration the issuer splits 2,006 into 固定席 1,842 and 移動席 156, and the 断面図/客席図 legend identifies the 156 as 移動席(オケピ) — movable seats in the orchestra-pit area, present when the pit is not used as a pit. Both subsets are inside the same A configuration and the same published total; they are not two configurations.
capacityAndSemanticsReconciliation.wheelchairInsideOrOutsidePublishedTotal: INSIDE. 1,842 + 156 + 8 = 2,006, so the 8 wheelchair positions are counted within the published A total, and within the printed 1階客席(1328席) subtotal. The City of Saitama page's 2,006席（車いす8席を含む） states the same relation independently.
capacityAndSemanticsReconciliation.wheelchairIndividualSeatIds: NONE OBSERVED. The chart draws 車椅子席（4席） twice — once at the 1F left and once at the 1F right — as unnumbered blocks. No per-position identifier is printed. Any future implementation must not invent IDs for these 8 positions.
capacityAndSemanticsReconciliation.wheelchairReplacementRelation: NOT STATED. The issuer publishes no replacement relation between the 8 wheelchair positions and adjacent numbered seats. No numbered seat may be presumptively deleted for them.
capacityAndSemanticsReconciliation.expectedMappedRelation: If the A configuration were ever implemented, the mapped numbered set would be the printed identifiers only, and the 8 unnumbered wheelchair positions would remain outside it as metadata, giving an expected rangeDiff of about −8 against the published 2,006. This is an expectation to be tested by a real two-pass, not a target to fit to.
capacityAndSemanticsReconciliation.crossConfigurationIdCollision: Not assessable, and not needed: only the A configuration has a published numbered set, so no ID is shared between two published numbered sets.

visualTwoPass.reason: The authorization sequences currentness confirmation before the fresh visual two-pass and production authoring. The currentness gate failed on an officially announced facility-wide closure inside the 12-month threshold, and the authorization directs returning the venue to a formal status rather than forcing an implementation. Transcribing roughly 2,000 positions into a source that policy forbids promoting, and that would be superseded by a two-year renovation, was therefore not performed. No partial or provisional transcription was recorded, and no pass result is claimed.

reopenCondition.recheckNotBeforeBasis: Derived from the issuer's announced closure start 2027-06-01 plus its stated approximately-2-year construction period. The issuer publishes no reopening date and states the period may change, so this is a discovery gate, not a claimed reopening date.
required: The issuer confirms the facility has reopened after the 中規模修繕工事 and is accepting bookings and events again.
The issuer publishes a post-renovation current 座席表（大ホール）. Pre-renovation culturecenter_zaseki01.pdf must not be treated as current after the closure begins.
The post-renovation material restates the representative configuration, including whether the A仕様/B仕様 distinction and the 固定席/移動席(オケピ)/車椅子席 split survive the renovation.
alsoResolvableButNotSufficientAlone: An issuer statement of which printed positions B仕様 removes, which would make B independently implementable rather than inference-only.
An issuer statement of whether the 8 wheelchair positions carry individual identifiers or replace specific numbered seats.
reopenCondition.notSufficient: The current pre-renovation chart, the matching 2,006 arithmetic, the facility being open for the next 9 months, and the 348 = 3F arithmetic coincidence are explicitly NOT sufficient to reopen this record for production.
